parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline one cognitive explanation of schizophrenia and delusional disorder.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the procedure in the study by Sensky et al. (2000) of cognitive-behavioural therapy
(CBT) for schizophrenia.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between CBT and biochemical treatments for
schizophrenia/delusional disorder.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe characteristics and measures of bipolar and related disorders.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate characteristics and measures of bipolar and related disorders, including a discussion
of validity. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
One stage in the consumer decision model when buying a product is ‘recognition of need’.
Identify two other stages from this model.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe two ways to close a sale.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
For one of the ways you described in (b):
Explain one advantage and one disadvantage of this way to close a sale.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about lighting, colour and smell in the physical
environment.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about lighting, colour and smell in the physical
environment, including a discussion about control of variables. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline the Yale model of communication in relation to health promotion.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the study by Lau et al. (1990) on health change in adolescents.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by Lau et al.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe what psychologists have discovered about measuring pain.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about measuring pain, including a discussion
of psychometrics. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Kouzes and Posner (1987) produced the Leadership Practices Inventory (LPI) which
measures five practices of exemplary leadership.
Identify two of these practices.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the styles of leader behaviour proposed by Muczyk and Reimann (1987).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between styles of leader behaviour (Muczyk and
Reimann, 1987) and situational leadership (Hersey and Blanchard, 1988).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about group development and roles in
organisations.

parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about group development and roles in
organisations, including a discussion of practical applications.
